title: Protection of Service Terms for a Commission Member

content.scenario: After being appointed as a member of the National Commission, a member, Ms. Kumar, finds that the government proposes to reduce the allowances of commission members. Ms. Kumar challenges this move, citing her right to non-variation of service terms.
content.outcome: The court upholds Ms. Kumar's challenge, ruling that the government cannot vary the service terms, including salary and allowances, to the disadvantage of the commission members after their appointment.
